BiblicalUsage: Saph was a Philistine of the sons of the giant, slain by Sibbechai the Hushathite in the battle at Gob. His name is one of the last giants named in David's wars, a reminder that the old enemies kept coming.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God finishes what He starts, and Saph's fall at Gob shows the giants of David's day going down one by one.
